verdict.rationale: Airbyte's typing-and-deduping feature explicitly maps each stream one-to-one to a typed destination table, eliminating raw JSON sub-tables, and schema-change management plus incremental/dedup sync modes support ongoing typed, deduplicated tables ready to query. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of typed-deduped output quality across destinations, and no evidence addressing edge cases like hard deletes which a community comment flagged as unclear.
